author: Astrokillah
text:
I am done with Pepperstone demo account. This is my December demo
results (+44.3% growth). I have achieved two consecutive months of +40%
account growth but it is not where I want to go. Because I'm not trading
 the real RTM way. In my mind, the real RTM way is to patiently wait for
 monster trades, 3-4 trades a month that gives 50RR to double my
account. But this month, I have failed to catch any of these monster
trades, and while most of my entries are based on RTM, and I always
closed half at first target (let the other half run), most of the time
the price reversed and stopped me out so my RR per trade isn't too
great.

In short, I am taking too many trades just to get to this point and I'm
not proud. I need to improve, and I need more help please! So I'm done
with Peppersone, a friend of mine recommend VantageFX, so I will test
their platform next, and I need to be trading with patience and
disciplines. Thanks to everyone who has helped me. I still have a long
long way to go!

author: Astrokillah
text:
Happy New Year and I wish all of you a great trading year ahead!

Having a good start to 2018, closed EURUSD long trade, LIVE account growth +3%.

The rational for going long on EURUSD is this:

I saw two clear LS (1 and 2), and looking at the strength of EURUSD
lately, I figure price has go up to hit these LS before reversing. In
the past, I would just sit and wait for price to get to these LS level
and then look for short opportunities. But now, having been in the Forex
 market for near 2 years, having seen how price are being manipulated
for the sole purpose of taking retailer's stop, I begin to develop some
confidence in predicting where price is likely to go. The strange thing
that I have noticed over and over again, is that when I set pending
order at a nice-looking level and wait for it to be triggered, more than
 90% of the time price did come as predicted and trigger my PO. But
after that, about 40%-50% of the time, price continue in the direction
against me and eventually broke my level and triggered my stops. So now I
 begin to wonder, perhaps trading towards a nice level is higher
probability that waiting at that level and expect price to bounce? Do
not try this as I'm still researching this way of trading. I need to get
 more definitive statistic and will share with the community.

So I took TP before price hit LS (2), but it now looks like I took TP tooo early, because price is moving up to LS (1)

What's up Ak

Just saw your post showing the December demo results. 44% return on
capital in a month is phenomenal. You should be very proud of yourself -
 I certainly can't get that kind of return in a month.

For what its worth.. here is my opinion:

There isn't only 'one' way to trade the market. RTM is a way of looking
at order flow in the market..it is a way to trade where the herd isn't.
It's trading with pro money. Everyone has a different strategy, but we
all tend to see the market in a similar way. All the great traders on
RTM have formed their own strategy which is informed by the basic
fundamental principles we all know are true about the market.

Getting 20+ RR trades is exciting and they do happen, but instead of re
working your strategy, I would put $50 bucks in a live account and see
if you can achieve the same monthly return with real money. If you can
do this consistently, stick with what you are doing and make it your
own.

Personally, I spent too much time trying to re create trades based on
what I saw other traders doing here on RTM. While it is important to
learn and expand your horizons by studying other trader's work, you will
 ultimately have to find your own path based on how you best understand
the market and process all that RTM has to offer. It wasn't until
spring/summer of 2017 when I started doing my own thing. And it has been
 amazing.

It is always important to evolve with the market and challenge yourself
to improve your trading.. with risk management and solid trade
psychology being the most important factor to trading success. But if
you are achieving 44% return per month with low drawdown, I wouldn't re
invent the wheel! Basic math shows us how powerful compounding interest
is and if you were achieving 1/3 of that return per month you would be a
 millionaire in no time.

Just a few humble thoughts, sorry for the long winded post....

I am happy for you and I wish you the best in 2018!!
